verdict: Yes, for a team that understands rural healthcare. Janitri pitched pregnancy monitoring systems on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. India still has high maternal and newborn mortality in many districts, and simple monitoring devices help nurses spot problems in time.
angle: Foetal heart monitors and labour monitoring devices help primary health centres and small hospitals. Government health programmes and state health missions are major buyers. Devices must be simple to use, affordable and approved.
